messages.subject: Project Cedar - completion arrangements and funds flow
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Priya,

We're set for exchange and completion on 7 May at our offices. Attached is the completion funds flow statement - cash payable at completion is £35.2m (£34.0m to the sellers via Castle & Vane plus £1.2m into the retention account), with the existing Northbank debt of £2.35m to be redeemed. Please arrange for the equity and debt funds to reach our client account by 9.30am on the 7th.

The completion checklist is attached to my next email.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0834
